description: The pie chart represents the domain distribution of the annotated AttrEval-GenSearch test set across various categories. The chart is divided into 12 slices, each representing a distinct category. The categories and their corresponding proportions are: AI/NLP Research (blue, 24.3%), Econ. & Fin. (light blue, 18.4%), Game&Anime (orange, 8.2%), Law (pink, 8.2%), Daily Life (teal, 7.1%), Med & Health (yellow, 6.7%), Science (lavender, 6.7%), Business (red, 5.9%), Pet & Animal (green, 5.5%), Law is not green but is 5.1%, Geography (dark green, 2.7%), and Math (brown, 1.2%). The chart includes percentage labels outside the slices, connected by lines to their corresponding categories, and does not include a legend. The slices are not visually emphasized or ordered in a particular way.
caption_used: The pie chart illustrates the domain distribution of the annotated AttrEval-GenSearch test set, encompassing twelve distinct categories. The largest category, 'AI/NLP Research,' accounts for approximately 24.3% of the dataset, followed by 'Econ. & Fin.' at 18.4%. 'History' and 'Game&Anime' are tied at 8.2%, while 'Daily Life' constitutes 7.1%. 'Med & Health' and 'Science' both represent 6.7%, with 'Business' slightly lower at 5.9%. 'Pet & Animal' and 'Law' are close in proportion, at 5.5% and 5.1%, respectively. 'Geography' and 'Math' are the smallest categories, with 'Geography' at 3.7% and 'Math' at 2.2%. Notably, 'Daily Life' has shown a consistent increase in representation compared to previous datasets, while 'Geography' has seen a slight decline.
